description: Compact after a fixed-width edit: Fx.Fb of row 5 is updated by UPDATE. Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, Decimal Fm and a trailing Text Vt); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm. Then DBEngine.CompactDatabase of the mutated file into a work file (the mutated file is unchanged); the public state is read before the mutation, after it and from the compacted file.  Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive. The compacted file is kept as a separate derivative (after-compact).
